status: M0 change map, generated from the OfficeIMO 3.5.3 net8.0 build (b7d2cf5137) by reflection plus source lookup. Signatures are reflection renderings: default values are unquoted and "CancellationToken cancellationToken = null" means "= default".

frameworks.change: Drop net8.0 and net472. One NET8_0_OR_GREATER condition stays valid.

notes: Depends on OfficeIMO.Html (which brings AngleSharp through OfficeIMO.Html.AngleSharp); conforms to the adapter rule.
Has a direct DocumentFormat.OpenXml package reference in addition to OfficeIMO.Word; check whether it is still needed.
openQuestions: To{Target} returns "the target document model", but HTML and Markdown->HTML currently return strings and HtmlConversionDocument is the HTML engine model. Decide whether ToHtml returns string or an HTML document type.

Static From{Source} on a type owned by another package (WordDocument.FromHtml in OfficeIMO.Word.Html, WordDocument.FromMarkdown, MarkdownDocument.FromHtml, WordDocument.FromPdf) is only possible with C# 14 static extension members. The SDK supports them for netstandard2.0 targets, but callers on older language versions (.NET Framework projects default to C# 7.3, Windows PowerShell) must call the containing static class directly. Alternative: keep instance forms on the source (pdf.ToWord(), html.ToWordDocument()) as the only adapter shape.

C# forbids out parameters on async methods, so "To{Target}/From{Source} have an overload with out OfficeConversionReport" cannot cover the async forms (FromHtmlAsync, LoadResultAsync, ToWordDocumentResultAsync). Choose: async forms return a (TDocument, OfficeConversionReport) result type, or async forms only throw/ignore loss.
